get.summary:
Every agent the user has access to, with or without absences, and their absences over a
period. Ordered by name, then by id.

post.summary:
Sets absences of several types over ranges of dates for several agents; each day replaces
the absence it had. Shifts on those days are deleted as in CreateAgentAbsence: without
delete_shifts nothing is written and the refusal lists the shifts of every agent, with it
everything is written.
post.description:
Refusals: service.request.too_large - more than the limit, sized for a team of 200 agents
over a month; service.agent.access (403) - no access to an agent.

get.summary:
A page of the schedule's agents with their days, and the holidays and working week of the
schedule's calendar.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page of agents, ordered by name and then by id; the filters apply first.

post.summary:
Expands a weekly template into shifts for several agents over a range of dates. Days with
an absence and days another active schedule locks are skipped and returned in skipped; the
rest is written.
post.description:
Refusals of the whole request: storage.shift.refused with violations - a shift overlaps
another shift of the agent, or the agent or the date is not of this schedule;
storage.working_schedule.archived; service.request.too_large - more than the limit, sized for
a team of 200 agents over a month.

days.description:
Map key is a day of week: 0 - Sunday, ..., 6 - Saturday. A day missing from the map gets
no shifts.

pauses.description:
Pauses of every day. Each belongs to the range that contains it; a pause outside
every range of a day refuses the request.

skills.description:
Skills switched on for the time of every shift the request creates. Different
skills for different ranges take separate requests.

schema.description:
A weekly template the server expands into shifts over a range of dates. Hours are
wall-clock minutes from midnight in the time zone of the schedule's calendar, so a shift
keeps its hours across a daylight saving change.

delete.summary:
Deletes a shift with its pauses and skills. Refusals as in UpdateAgentWorkingScheduleShift,
except the shift rules.

put.summary:
Replaces one shift whole: its time, and the pauses and skills of the request replace the
existing ones, so a pause is deleted by sending the shift without it. Needs the etag from a
read; the response carries the shift with the new etag. Allowed in a draft, pending or
active schedule.
put.description:
Refusals: storage.shift.version_conflict (409) - the shift changed since the read;
storage.shift.refused with violations - the rules of CreateAgentsWorkingScheduleShifts, plus
an absence or a locked date; storage.working_schedule.archived; dbsql.query.no_rows (404) -
the shift is gone.

start_at.description: Epoch milliseconds. The shift ends right before end_at, so the next one can start at end_at.

working_date.description:
Set by the server. The working date, a date as in DateRange: the day the shift starts
on in the time zone of the schedule's calendar, so a night shift belongs to the day it
starts. 00:00 UTC of that day, epoch milliseconds.

etag.description: Version of the shift, returned by every read. Editing and deleting a shift require it.

planner_run_id.description: Set by the server for a planner's shift: the planning run that wrote it.

shift.description:
The shift with its id and the etag from a read. start_at, end_at, pauses and skills are
written; the server sets the rest.
shift.title:
The shift with its id and the etag from a read. start_at, end_at, pauses and skills are
written; the server sets the rest.

post.summary:
Sets an absence for one day. An agent has one absence a day and a new one replaces the old
one of any type, so adding and changing the type is the same call. Past days are allowed.
post.description:
The agent's shifts on that day in a draft, pending or active schedule are deleted only on
confirmation. Without delete_shifts the call writes nothing and refuses with
storage.absence.shifts_to_delete, listing those shifts as storage.absence.shift violations.
With delete_shifts the shifts, their pauses and skills are deleted in the same transaction
and returned in deleted_shifts. Shifts of an archived schedule stay, next to the absence.

Refusals: service.agent.access (403) - no access to the agent.

delete_shifts.description: Deletes the agent's shifts on that day, the ones storage.absence.shifts_to_delete listed.

get.summary: Reads one absence per agent by its id.

delete.summary: Deletes an absence by its id; dbsql.query.no_rows (404) if there is none.

put.summary:
Updates an absence by its id, with the result of CreateAgentAbsence. On a day with shifts it
refuses with storage.absence.shifts_to_delete and has no confirmation.

absent_at.description: A date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

put.summary:
UpdatePauseTemplateCauseBulk updates a pause template with a list of causes.
Update existing cause, create that not exists in database and delete that not exists in the list.

UpdateShiftTemplate updates a shift template with a list times.
Update existing time, create that not exists in database and delete that not exists in the list.

get.summary: Searches schedules, each with its number of agents.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: States sort as active, pending, draft, archived.

post.summary:
A new schedule is always a draft, whatever state the request carries. It gets every agent
of the team the user has access to; agents who join the team later are added by hand.

delete.summary:
Deletes the schedule with its shifts, pauses and skills; absences stay. An active schedule
refuses with storage.working_schedule.active until its state changes.

post.summary:
Adds agents from any team, each once: an agent already in the schedule is skipped. The
response lists the added ones, with names.

delete.summary: Removes an agent with their shifts in this schedule; absences stay.

patch.summary:
Switches blocking outside a shift on or off in a draft, pending or active schedule, with the
etag from a read; the response carries the schedule with the new etag. After creation it is
the only way to change it. Switched on in an active schedule, it also takes agents who are
online outside their shift offline.
patch.description:
Refusals: storage.working_schedule.archived; storage.working_schedule.version_conflict
(409) - the header changed since the read.

get.summary:
How many agents each hour of a period needs, from the forecast procedure of the team. The
procedure runs on every call and nothing is stored, so edits of the schedule do not change
the result. A team without a forecast calculation gets no hours.

How many agents are on a shift and not on a pause, per 15 minutes and per day. It reads
only the schedule, so every edit of it changes the result.

patch.summary:
Moves the schedule to another state, in any order but out of archived, with the etag from
a read; the response carries the schedule with the new etag.
patch.description:
Moving to pending or active needs an answer about unplanned days: dates of the period where
an agent of the schedule has neither a shift nor an absence. Without fill_days_off the call
refuses with service.working_schedule.unplanned_days. The days off are written in the same
transaction, as absences.

Moving to active first checks the rules and refuses with
storage.working_schedule.activation_refused and violations:
storage.working_schedule.team_active - the team has another active schedule on overlapping
dates; storage.shift.locked_date or storage.shift.overlap - an agent works in another active
schedule on the same date or at the same time. storage.working_schedule.version_conflict
(409) - the header changed since the read.

fill_days_off.description:
The answer about unplanned days: true fills them with days off, holidays and the calendar's
days off included; false leaves them empty. Absent, the call refuses if there are any.

put.summary:
Updates the header of a draft schedule, with the etag from a read; the response carries the
new etag. A change of the team rebuilds the schedule: every shift is deleted and the agents
become the new team's agents the user has access to, so agents added by hand leave too. A
change of the calendar deletes every shift; a change of the dates deletes the shifts whose
working date falls outside the new period. The time scale, the name and Special time skills
keep the shifts. block_outside_activity is ignored: only
UpdateWorkingScheduleBlockOutsideActivity changes it.
put.description:
Refusals: service.working_schedule.state - not a draft;
storage.working_schedule.version_conflict (409) - the header changed since the read.

state.description: Set by the server: a new schedule is a draft, and only UpdateWorkingScheduleState changes it.

start_date_at.description:
The first and the last day of the schedule, dates as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the
day, epoch milliseconds.

start_time_at.description:
The time scale of the schedule, minutes from midnight in the zone of its calendar. Both
absent mean 24 hours; an end before the start crosses midnight. It does not limit shifts.

extra_skills.description: Special time skills; the shape may change to a skill group.

block_outside_activity.description:
Off by default. Set on creation; afterwards only UpdateWorkingScheduleBlockOutsideActivity
changes it.

etag.description:
Version of the row, returned by every read. UpdateWorkingSchedule, UpdateWorkingScheduleState
and UpdateWorkingScheduleBlockOutsideActivity require it and refuse with
storage.working_schedule.version_conflict (409) when the schedule has changed since.

date_from.description: Dates as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds; date_to is included.

absent_at.description: A date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

date.description: The working date, a date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

locked.description: The agent has shifts in another active schedule on this date, so no shift goes here.

absence.description: A day has an absence or shifts, not both.

absence_id.description: Id of the absence, to delete it.

start_at.description: Epoch milliseconds. The shift ends right before end_at, so the next one can start at end_at.

working_date.description:
Set by the server. The working date, a date as in DateRange: the day the shift starts
on in the time zone of the schedule's calendar, so a night shift belongs to the day it
starts. 00:00 UTC of that day, epoch milliseconds.

etag.description: Version of the shift, returned by every read. Editing and deleting a shift require it.

planner_run_id.description: Set by the server for a planner's shift: the planning run that wrote it.

wfmAgentScheduleShiftSkill.description:
AgentScheduleShiftSkill switches a skill the agent already has on or off for the time
of the shift, with the agent's own capacity (WFM-114).

ranges.description: Working hours, wall-clock minutes from midnight in the calendar's zone.

deleted_shifts.description:
The shifts deleted. They can differ from the ones the refusal listed if the schedule
changed in between.

skipped.description:
Days the request left without shifts, and why: storage.shift.absence, or
storage.shift.locked_date with the schedule that holds the date.

wfmDateRange.description:
DateRange is an inclusive range of calendar dates. A date anywhere in WFM is a day, not
an instant: 00:00 UTC of that day in epoch milliseconds, the same for every client
whatever its time zone. Any other value is refused, so a local midnight shows up as
an error instead of a day shifted by the client's offset.

date.description: The working date, a date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

wfmDeletedShift.description: DeletedShift is a shift an absence deleted.

date.description:
The day of the hour in the zone of the schedule's calendar, a date as in DateRange:
00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

start_at.description: Start of the hour, epoch milliseconds.

date.description: A date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.
A date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds.

start_at.description: Start of the slot, epoch milliseconds.

slots.description:
15-minute slots where at least one agent is on a shift and not on a pause; a slot missing
from the list has 0. An agent counts as away only when a pause covers the whole slot.

days.description: Days where at least one agent has a shift, by working date.

week.description:
Map key is a day of week as in the Add shifts template: 0 - Sunday, ..., 6 - Saturday.
Every day is present; a day without ranges is a day off.

items.description: An agent without absences in the period comes without absences.

total.description: Agents that match the filters, on all pages.
Agents that match the filters, on all pages; 0 on a page past the last one.

calendar.description:
The calendar of the schedule, to tell working days from days off and to show
times in its zone.

wfmShiftTemplateDay.description:
ShiftTemplateDay holds the shifts of one day of week, several when the agent works
on different skills at different hours.

wfmShiftTemplatePause.description:
ShiftTemplatePause is a pause of every day at a wall-clock time. In a range that
crosses midnight, a pause after 00:00 belongs to the shift of the previous day.

wfmShiftTemplateRange.description:
ShiftTemplateRange is one shift of a day, in minutes from midnight. An end before the
start crosses midnight: 1320 to 360 is 22:00 to 06:00, a shift of the day it starts on.

agent.description: Absent when the rule is about the schedule as a whole.

date.description:
A date as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the day, epoch milliseconds. Absent when the rule is
about the schedule as a whole.

schedule.description: The other schedule the rule is about, if any.

shift_id.description:
The existing shift the rule is about, if any: the one an absence deletes, or the one a new
shift overlaps. Absent when the overlap is between two new shifts of the same request.

start_at.description: Start and end of that shift, epoch milliseconds.

wfmViolation.description:
A WFM error has the body {"id", "code", "status", "detail"}. Errors are told apart by id, not
by HTTP status: 400 is both a validation error and a business refusal, 409 both a version
conflict and a duplicate. detail is a fallback text for people; a refusal with violations
puts JSON there instead: {"text": "...", "violations": [Violation, ...]}, with the field names
of this API.

Common to every WFM method: interceptor.validate (400) - an invalid request;
interceptor.auth.license and interceptor.auth.permission (403) - no WFM license or no right on
the object class; service.agent.access (403) - no access to the agent, never 404;
dbsql.query.no_rows (404) - the record is gone; storage.working_schedule.archived (400) - a
write to an archived schedule, which is read-only. After a version conflict (409) the record
has to be read again.
wfmViolation.title:
Violation is one broken rule: which agent, on which date, why, and which other schedule
or shift is in the way. A refusal lists the rules it broke; reasons are told apart by id:
  storage.shift.agent_not_in_schedule - the agent is not in the schedule
  storage.shift.agent_deactivated - the agent's user is deactivated
  storage.shift.outside_schedule - the date is outside the schedule's period
  storage.shift.absence - the agent has an absence on the date
  storage.shift.locked_date - the agent has shifts in another active schedule on the date
  storage.shift.overlap - the shift overlaps another shift of the agent, a night one included
  storage.absence.shift - the agent has a shift on the date in a draft, pending or active
    schedule, which the absence deletes once confirmed
  storage.working_schedule.team_active - the team already has an active schedule on
    overlapping dates; no agent or date

state.description: Set by the server: a new schedule is a draft, and only UpdateWorkingScheduleState changes it.

The first and the last day of the schedule, dates as in DateRange: 00:00 UTC of the

start_time_at.description:
The time scale of the schedule, minutes from midnight in the zone of its calendar. Both
absent mean 24 hours; an end before the start crosses midnight. It does not limit shifts.

extra_skills.description: Special time skills; the shape may change to a skill group.

block_outside_activity.description:
Off by default. Set on creation; afterwards only UpdateWorkingScheduleBlockOutsideActivity
